dedupe_keys.name: livestock forage disaster program lfp eligibility by county 2008 2025 sustainable fsa archive

description: County eligibility determinations for the USDA Livestock Forage Disaster Program, which pays livestock producers for grazing losses from drought and fire, for program years 2008 to 2025. The Zenodo record, version 2026.07.29 published on 30 July 2026 by the USDA Farm Service Agency and R. Kyle Bocinsky (Montana Climate Office) as part of the Sustainable FSA Archive, has one record per FSA county, program year, pasture type and disaster type: 51,348 records across 2,843 FSA counties and 2,836 Census counties. Outputs are CSV and Parquet mirrors, a QA report, dashboard assets and FOIA correspondence, in a zip of about 16 MB, free under CC0 1.0, also mirrored to S3. The notes for this version describe re-keying on FSA county codes to recover 72 determinations lost when several FSA offices share one Census county, and removing 29 duplicates. Caveats: FSA county codes differ from Census FIPS codes, and eligibility is not the same as payments made. For simulation it gives an official, county-level record of when drought or fire triggered forage disaster support, to calibrate drought impacts on livestock and agricultural relief. Related catalogue records include the USDA RMA cause of loss data and the US Drought Monitor.
